SCI-FRUIT v0.1 r0.4 — FINAL STAGE A
ADDITIVE-SPACE, RESPONSE-CATALOG, AND PACKET-PARITY AMENDMENT

The SCI-FRUIT r0.4 architecture is accepted.

Do not perform another broad Stage A derivation.

Preserve:

- the A/B/C separation among program-order authority, conditional-composition
  authority, and numerical-method authority;
- no numerical method selection;
- no Stage B launch before exact packet approval;
- distinct candidate, accepted, and applied models;
- use of the applied model in removal and rejoin;
- the corrected fixed-linear expansion;
- D_k only under complete linearity of A_k, Pi_k, and B_k;
- method identity distinct from state, coefficient, model, and application
  generation;
- route-conditional parent quantity and unit;
- no default recurrence;
- immutable original-parent ancestry;
- universal core completion gates;
- grouping as method identity;
- path-specific support and information origin;
- model-only content as model/prior-supported and not acquired exposure;
- FRUIT-FEEDBACK-METHOD as a family with method-specific identities;
- every existing nonclaim.

======================================================================
1. BIND THE ADDITIVE STRUCTURE, REFERENCE, GAUGE, AND NULL SPACE
======================================================================

The generic remove-process-rejoin equations use subtraction in Y_k and addition
in Z_k. State the exact premises that make those operations meaningful.

Require:

    Pi_k(m_k^applied)

to be subtractable from:

    y_k^in

only under exact compatibility of:

- scientific quantity;
- unit and numerical scale;
- coordinate frame and domain;
- grid/sampling;
- support;
- additive origin/reference or gauge;
- null-space state;
- calibration convention;
- response convention.

Require:

    F_k(rho_k)

and:

    B_k(m_k^applied)

to be addable in one exact compatible Z_k quantity space under the same classes
of facts.

Declare Y_k and Z_k as exact additive quantity spaces, or as explicitly
identified affine/quotient spaces with one declared reference and gauge.

If an upstream operation leaves an absolute or other additive mode unavailable,
FRUIT shall not silently manufacture observational authority for that mode.

A model rejoined in such a mode remains:

    model_or_prior_supported

and does not become:

    observationally_measured
    recovered_from_data
    acquired_exposure
    unit_response_truth.

Bind the additive-reference and null-space consequences in the method record,
iteration bundle, response family, uncertainty family, support/origin table,
and predictions.

======================================================================
2. RECONCILE RF-03 AND RF-07
======================================================================

The r0.4 scope presently lists:

    RF-03 one-step FRUIT full-procedure response

and:

    RF-07 FRUIT full-procedure response with upstream parent held fixed.

Do not retain overlapping response identities.

Preferred seven-role interpretation:

    RF-01
      fixed one-step response to the measured iteration input, with model and
      all state fixed;

    RF-02
      fixed one-step response to the applied model, with measured input and
      all state fixed;

    RF-03
      one-iteration FRUIT full-procedure response, rerunning model construction,
      selection, state resolution, support, coefficient realization, and
      application for that one iteration, while prior FRUIT state and the
      upstream producer procedure remain fixed;

    RF-04
      recursive response through a predeclared fixed iteration sequence or
      fixed absolute iteration index;

    RF-05
      selected-terminal response including convergence, stopping, resource
      limit, and terminal-selection behavior;

    RF-06
      whole-chain response, rerunning every included data-dependent upstream
      producer and the declared FRUIT procedure;

    RF-07
      complete FRUIT-only procedure response to a declared perturbation of the
      realized parent-domain payload, including recurrence and terminal
      selection as applicable, while the upstream producer operation, learned
      state, and generation are held fixed.

RF-07 is a composed full-FRUIT procedure role. Its relation to RF-03, RF-04,
and RF-05 shall be explicit.

Do not say that the numerical upstream parent is “held fixed” when its payload
is perturbed. Say that the upstream producer procedure and state are fixed.

If RF-03 already has the complete RF-07 meaning, merge them and retain six
roles. Return an exact supersession/crosswalk rather than two aliases.

For every response role bind:

- perturbation source and domain;
- fixed versus rerun state;
- recurrence and terminal-selection scope;
- baseline and perturbed comparability;
- branch/support/state changes;
- codomain;
- derivative or finite-difference convention;
- unavailable and discontinuity behavior.

Replace “the first six required roles” with:

    all response-role identities and typed statuses required by the applicable
    method and claim.

A required status may truthfully be unavailable. Do not imply universal
numerical response availability.

======================================================================
3. MAKE ALL THREE MODEL SPACES EXPLICIT
======================================================================

Bind:

    M_k^candidate
    M_k^accepted
    M_k^applied

and the exact transformations, if any, among them.

Do not assume equal:

- domain;
- support;
- unit;
- normalization;
- sign;
- representation;
- response;
- uncertainty;
- parentage.

Equality among any two is an exact method/state fact.

======================================================================
4. REMOVE ITERATION-COUNT AMBIGUITY
======================================================================

Use:

    After completion of the iteration with absolute zero-based index N,
    continuation begins at absolute index N+1 from S_(N+1).

Do not use “after completed N” in a way that can mean either a count or an
index.

======================================================================
5. VERIFY TERMINAL-SELECTION STATE
======================================================================

The terminal-selection record shall contain or type unavailable:

- selected completed-iteration identity;
- complete candidate iteration population considered;
- exact selection rule and generation;
- convergence, stopping, and resource-limit facts;
- selection causes;
- selected-terminal response;
- selected-terminal uncertainty;
- continuation or terminality state;
- downstream named-use status references.

It shall not mutate, relabel, or replace the selected iteration bundle.

======================================================================

======================================================================

Return the exact bytes of:

- revised Scope Brief;
- SCIENTIFIC_OWNER_DECISION_LEDGER.md;

- frozen PTC fragment and cover;
- PROGRAM_REFERENCE.md;
- Stage A semantic-change report;
- AUTHOR_INPUT_MANIFEST.md;
- manifest sidecar;
- compressed packet and archive sidecar.

Verify:

- distinct candidate, accepted, and applied model spaces and roles;
- additive-reference/gauge/null-space compatibility;
- complete linearity premises for D_k;
- method identity versus realized-state identity;
- route-conditional quantity;
- exact nonoverlapping response catalog;
- seven operation-state categories;
- eight support/information-origin roles;
- complete covariance including parent-model cross terms;
- all twenty predictions;
- universal completion gates;
- method-family and method-instance identities;
- exact A/B/C authority separation;
- zero unresolved bundle-local links;
- reproducible byte counts and SHA-256 values.

======================================================================
7. STAGE B DISPOSITION
======================================================================

After Grant Wilson approves the exact amended packet bytes, launch Stage B in a
fresh implementation-blind thread.

Stage B may author and later seek conditional freeze of the generic
SCI-FRUIT core while every numerical parent, model, recurrence, stopping,
response, covariance, and downstream-use route remains unavailable.

It shall not infer a familiar FRUIT algorithm, existing implementation
behavior, or numerical default.

No Stage A approval or Stage B draft establishes numerical availability,
implementation conformity, recovered sky modes, response/covariance fidelity,
uncertainty coverage, convergence adequacy, Pointing/OOF/catalogue fitness,
observational validation, performance, readiness, production suitability,
production authorization, or Unity activity.
